incidents.description: Several broad text/image tool outputs exceeded the display budget. incidents.description: Initial own tensor-product helper used an unsupported mpmath matrix constructor callback. It produced a zero tensor matrix and the first ambient control failed at singular A after four exact geometry cases. Replaced that helper by explicit element loops; same cases, 120-digit precision and 1e-95 tolerance, no parameter search. Final12controls pass.
incidents.impact: Reviewer code error, not a manuscript counterexample. Initial failure retained; repeated exact checks not counted as independent confirmations.
